Anya (PM): Quick sync — field asked for a longer pin TTL for a set of enterprise customers to avoid migration churn. They want 6 months. Thoughts on scope and gating?
Carlos (Field SE): We're seeing this from 3 big customers. Main ask: pin current model version during contract. Risk = drift + maintenance.
Mei (Solutions): Can we offer a 'gracepin' that auto-rolls forward only if benchmarks stay within threshold? Field specifically said no automatic rollbacks without customer notification.
Ravi (Eng Lead): Technical note: long pins are OK but increase ops surface area. Need explicit launch gates: perf/quality benchmarks, limited canary, automation for emergency rollback.
Anya (PM): Proposed gates: (1) benchmark pass on tenant-supplied dataset, (2) canary at ~10% traffic for 48h, (3) documented escape hatch + runbook. Agree?
Joan (ProdOps): Also need to confirm SLA implications. If we keep an older model for a tenant, can we promise latency/cost parity? Marketing/legal will need a short comms doc.
Carlos (Field SE): Customers prioritize predictability over cost. Marketing can help with messaging but legal needs a clause for pin exceptions.
Ravi (Eng Lead): Bench specifics proposal: 95th pct latency within 120% of their current prod baseline, and eval on 3 representative prompt sets with at most 2% accuracy/regression delta. Need instrumentation to surface these signals to ops.
Anya (PM): Add a "pin-health" composite metric (latency delta, error rate, quality delta). If any submetric trips, trigger a hold and page product + field for manual decision.
deploy-bot: pin-health webhook configured -> posting to #eng-oncall and #product during working hours.
Mei (Solutions): Operational flow idea: field submits a pin request with tenant artifact + benchmark CSV -> infra auto-validates perf thresholds -> product approves -> pin issued. Keep a manual override for emergency unpin.
Joan (ProdOps): I'll draft a comms template and a one-page SOW clause outlining TTL options and rollback terms.
Carlos (Field SE): :thumbsup: Can TTL be configurable per customer? Some will want 3 months, others 12.
Ravi (Eng Lead): We can make TTL a param on the pin resource. Add guardrails: default max 6 months, require exec approval for >6 months, absolute cap 12 months.
Anya (PM): Action items: Ravi to spec pin-health metrics + TTL guardrail by EOD Wed; Joan to draft SOW/comms; Mei to prototype request flow; I'll coordinate legal and field sign-off. Thanks all.
